Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On August 12, 2026

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported a revenue of ₹1011.33 crore for FY 2024-25, marking a 10.82% increase over the previous year. The company achieved a profit before tax of ₹152.99 crore and a profit after tax of ₹113.88 crore. Management highlighted the successful expansion and modernization of production facilities in Pundhra and Bareilly. The company also announced a dividend of ₹21 per share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. Vadilal Industries Limited reported a revenue of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian ice cream market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of approximately 14.79% from 2024 to 2031.
demand_outlook.quote: Over recent years, India’s ice cream market has experienced rapid expansion, reflecting broader economic growth trends, growing at a robust compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of approximately 14.79 % from 2024-2031.

demand_outlook.claim: The global frozen food market is projected to reach USD 712.8 billion by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 6.0%.
demand_outlook.quote: The global frozen food market was valued at USD 503.75 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach USD 712.8 billion by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 6.0%.

demand_outlook.claim: The ice cream market is experiencing a resurgence in growth following the COVID era.
demand_outlook.quote: Following the aftermath of the COVID era, the ice cream market is experiencing a notable resurgence in growth at 12-14 percent.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the impulse category of ice creams to continue its dominance in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s ice cream market was dominated by the ‘impulse’ category of ice creams since the past 8 years, and this category is further expected to continue its dominance during the forecast period as well, owing to growing demand for premium ice creams and changing consumer taste.

demand_outlook.claim: The ice cream market in India is forecasted to exhibit a CAGR of 17.41% during 2022-2028.
demand_outlook.quote: The ice cream market in India is forecasted to exhibit a CAGR of 17.41% during 2022-2028.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully executed a comprehensive expansion and modernization drive at its production hubs in Pundhra and Bareilly.
capex_expansion.quote: Our production hubs are located in Pundhra (Gandhinagar, Gujarat) and Bareilly (Uttar Pradesh). To further scale operations and improve automation, both facilities underwent a comprehensive expansion and modernization drive, which has now been successfully executed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed an expansion-cum-modernization project at its ice cream manufacturing facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: To increase the production capacity and to have better automation, an expansion-cum-modernization project of the factories was undertaken, which has been successfully completed.

margins_costs.claim: The company is monitoring rising input costs and supply-side pressures through operational efficiencies and strategic procurement planning.
margins_costs.quote: Rising input costs, cold chain infrastructure, and supply-side pressures are areas of concern. The company continues to monitor and manage these risks through operational efficiencies and strategic procurement planning.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved better operational efficiency during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: During the current financial year of 2023-24, the Company has acheived Marginal growth and better operational efficiency as compared to previous financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a cone-producing machine with a daily output of 23 lakh cones.
orders_capacity.quote: We take immense pride in operating the country’s fastest cone-producing machine, with an impressive daily output of 23 lakh cones.

orders_capacity.claim: The company manufactures 5.5 lakh litres of ice cream daily.
orders_capacity.quote: Every day, we manufacture 5.5 lakh litres of delightful ice cream to meet growing consumer demand.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ice cream production capacity includes a cone-making machine capable of producing 13 lakh cones per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Vadilal proudly possesses the label of having, India’s fastest cone-making machine, with the production capacity 13 lakh cones per day.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's daily ice cream production capacity is 625,000 liters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our daily production capacity enables us to craft 625,000 liters of delicious ice cream, utilizing 24,600 kilograms of fresh milk each day.

orders_capacity.claim: The company possesses a cone-making machine with a production capacity of 13 lakh cones per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Vadilal proudly possesses the label of having, India’s fastest cone-making machine, with a production capacity of 13 lakh cones per day.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of ₹21 per share for the financial year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors have recommended dividend of ` 21 per share (@210%) on 71,87,830 Equity Shares of ` 10/- each of the Company for the Financial Year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company availed a new term loan of ₹39 crore from ICICI Bank for capex purposes, with ₹22.13 crore partially disbursed.
capital_allocation.quote: Company has also been sanctioned a new term loan from ICICI Bank for ` 39 Crore for capex purpose and availed ` 22.13 Crore as a partial disbursement.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transitioned to a multiple banking arrangement for its working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: For smooth business operation Company has dissolved the consortium banking arrangement and take the exit from Bank of Baroda and State Bank of India and started new banking arrangement under Multiple banking arrangement (M.B.A.) where in ICICI Bank has sanctioned Working Capital Facility of Rs. 50 Crore and other existing members, namely IDBI Bank and IndusInd Bank will also continue under M.B.A.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 1.50 per share for FY 2022-23.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors have recommended dividend of ` 1.50 per share (@15%) on 71,87,830 Equity Shares of ` 10/- each of the Company for the Financial Year ended on 31st March, 2023.

risks_headwinds.claim: Climate-related disruptions and geopolitical tensions have caused fluctuations in raw material availability and freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Climate-related disruptions in key agricultural regions and geopolitical tensions affecting global trade routes have contributed to occasional fluctuations in raw material availability and freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces competition from unorganized players in the ice cream industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Like every other industry, the ice cream industry has a vast unorganized market that works at low costs and margins. These unorganized players pose the biggest challenge and are a competition to the big players.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain disruptions and rising energy costs are identified as challenges for the frozen food and ice cream industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The frozen food and ice cream industry faces challenges, including supply chain disruptions, rising energy costs, and stricter regulations.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Russia-Ukraine conflict has caused global supply chain disruptions and inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Russia-Ukraine conflict has disrupted the chances of global economic recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic, at least in the short term. Economic sanctions on multiple countries, surging commodity prices, and supply chain disruptions have caused inflation across goods and services, affecting many markets globally.

management_commitments.claim: M/s. PricewaterhouseCoopers Services LLP are appointed as Internal Auditors for a period of two years.
management_commitments.quote: M/s. PricewaterhouseCoopers Services LLP are appointed as Internal Auditors of the Company for the period of two years w.e.f. 1st October, 2025 to 30th September, 2027 in place of M/s. KPMG, present internal auditors of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to maintain sustainable annual growth in its ice cream division.
management_commitments.quote: Vadilal Ice Cream division has shown a sustainable annual growth and aims at maintaining it further in the years to come.
